title: Explain invalid task-only envelopes without memory-repair guidance
outcome: Make task-only export's treatment of an invalid committed envelope with no memories consistent with its code, recovery guidance and documented behavior.
acceptance: On a committed data HEAD with no memories and a malformed, incomplete, unsupported or nonordinary project envelope, task-only export has an explicitly chosen and documented repair/refusal behavior, reports an applicable reason and next step, and a behavioral test covers it without losing shared data.
